label: About
title: About Card Rift Under Green Weather
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1210 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @serpentinedumb1: Alfredo Castañeda, Player (1977) and Detroit Is Changing Fast. Here’s What Locals Think Its Future Should Look Like, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Card Rift Under Green Weather: Cinematic still, side-lit object slab: a broad dark gray-green wall drops into a saturated green tabletop band with one hard horizontal seam. A large central charcoal mass, half figure and half staged source object, anchors the plate. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against torn black eye aperture, central draped cloth mass, and green civic felt slab.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
